title: Pressure-Instrument Diagnostic Entry - Bounded Charge-Diagnostic Scope
governing_proposition: Has sufficient Admissible Evidence, Applicable Authority, and Established Standing been established, NOW, to justify connecting pressure instruments to obtain refrigerant-side pressure evidence for the stated refrigerant-charge question?

output_boundary.statement: Permission to connect gauges != permission to move refrigerant.

scope.question: REFRIGERANT_CHARGE_ONLY
scope.equipment: Ducted split-system air conditioner or heat pump; single- or two-stage; non-inverter
scope.refrigerant: Non-A2L refrigerant declared on the equipment nameplate; no A2L red markings or flammable-refrigerant labels
oem_data: Published applicable OEM charging method/data for the identified model
Published applicable OEM airflow/static-pressure data for the identified model
scope.technician: EPA Section 608 certified technician, or apprentice under direct supervision of a certified technician, under a diagnostic work scope
scope.outside_scope_result: Fail closed to HOLD or ESCALATE per logic

prerequisites.P01: Indoor and outdoor equipment identity (manufacturer, indoor model, outdoor model) recorded, and the pairing established by a VERIFIED governed OEM reference record naming that exact manufacturer and indoor/outdoor combination (Amendment A7); a declared pairing may restrict, never grant
prerequisites.P02: Declared refrigerant recorded; non-A2L (no red-marked ports/pipes/hoses, no flammable-refrigerant labels); instruments rated for that refrigerant
prerequisites.P03: Metering-device type established from direct/configuration evidence; never inferred from pressure
prerequisites.P04: OEM-prescribed minimum continuous run completed with no compressor interruption and no charge change during the run
prerequisites.P05: Instruments valid: calibrated per instrument-manufacturer interval, correct setup and placement
prerequisites.P06: Evaporator free of ice; if icing occurred, TA-14 ice restoration sequence complete
prerequisites.P07: Any pre-Gate-A correction recorded (declared finding, applicable authority, before-condition record, bounded correction, after-condition record) and new operating baseline established
prerequisites.P08: Measured indoor airflow within OEM range by an OEM method or an ANSI/ACCA 5 QI-2015 section 4.1.2 method
prerequisites.P09: Measured external static pressure within OEM range
prerequisites.P10: Heat rejection valid: panels in place, condenser coil not materially restricted, condenser fan operating
prerequisites.P11: Outdoor ambient within the OEM envelope for the OEM method used
prerequisites.P12: Entering-evaporator dry-bulb and wet-bulb (or RH) measured at steady state
prerequisites.P13: Fresh internally coherent measurement set within one steady-state window, with no invalidating event since
prerequisites.P14: OEM charging method identified for this model from a VERIFIED, CURRENT governed OEM reference record with complete record, document and custody provenance, independently reviewed (Amendments A5, A7); manual transcription never satisfies P14
prerequisites.P15: Request not based solely on a prohibited basis; evaluated at the indication step per Amendment A2
prerequisites.P17: Execution authority (A6): submitter authenticated; 608 certification (Type II or Universal, or supervised apprentice with such a supervisor) independently VERIFIED per A4; and no declared or established restriction (work scope excludes diagnosis, site permission withheld or unconfirmed, jurisdiction unconfirmed or required-not-confirmed, identity mismatch). Grants of work scope, site permission and jurisdiction are not required by Gate A; they belong to the field-authority layer.
prerequisites.P18: Indication established via I1 or I2, against the single OEM-published criterion candidate whose published applicability conditions contain the measured conditions (Amendment A7); no interpolation, calculation or unrepresented lookup

conditional.C01: If OEM criterion requires leaving-air (supply) readings: measure at OEM location; OEM location absent -> HOLD
conditional.C02: If OEM criterion requires suction/liquid line temperatures: measure at OEM location; OEM location absent -> HOLD
conditional.C03: If voltage relevant to OEM operating envelope: within nameplate/OEM range else HOLD
conditional.C04: Compressor not running steadily or abnormal cycling: fails P04 -> HOLD
conditional.C06: OEM-specified measured-stability criterion applies in addition to P04
conditional.C07: OEM-specified airflow method governs; otherwise ACCA 5 QI section 4.1.2; temperature-rise never for cooling airflow
conditional.C08: Leak indications recorded only; not a charge indication; leak question outside scope

indication.I1: Indicator interval lies entirely OUTSIDE the OEM-published criterion for this model (F1), with airflow established WITHIN OEM range
indication.I2: TA-14 policy: I1 evidence valid but ambiguous against OEM criterion AND >=2 plausible charge-related hypotheses remain AND valid non-invasive evidence cannot discriminate AND the OEM pressure-based method would discriminate; contradiction alone never qualifies

logic.precedence: DENY > ESCALATE > HOLD > ALLOW; empty requirement set -> HOLD; D1/D2 evaluated only after all HOLD/ESCALATE checks pass; D3 and D4 apply regardless; A6: technical_determination is derived from INPUT, SCOPE, P01-P16 and P18; execution_authority from P17 and ENTRY; determination (pressure-instrument entry authorized) combines both with the same precedence; D1/D2 are evaluated after all technical HOLD/ESCALATE checks pass
logic.ALLOW: All P01-P17 satisfied AND P18 via I1 or I2
HOLD: Any P01-P17 missing, invalid, or stale
Frozen/materially iced evaporator or TA-14 restoration incomplete
Airflow or ESP outside OEM range
Voltage out of range where applicable
OEM data/criterion not yet obtained but obtainable
Authority documents missing or jurisdictional authorization unconfirmed
Any ambiguous comparison per F1, or missing instrument accuracy
I2 predicates not establishable by the engine in C1
Certification declared/documented but not verified, or verification evidence incomplete or self-supplied (A4)
Submitter unauthenticated; authority element not established, incomplete, or self-established; OEM reference not verified, incomplete, or self-verified (A5)

DENY.D1: All P01-P17 satisfied and the indicator interval lies entirely WITHIN the OEM-published criterion (F1) with no I2 condition: pressure-side diagnostic entry not currently indicated/justified
DENY.D2: Request rests solely on a prohibited basis, all other prerequisites satisfied, and the indicator interval lies entirely WITHIN the OEM criterion (Amendment A2)
DENY.D4: Pressure-instrument entry proposed or attempted before Gate-A ALLOW: PRESSURE_INSTRUMENT_ENTRY_NOT_AUTHORIZED (Amendment A1)

ESCALATE: OEM data/criterion unobtainable and no TA-14-adopted method applies
OEM procedure requires unavailable tools or modes
Metering device or identity unestablishable even from OEM documents
Technician not certified and not supervised apprentice, or out of scope
Authority establishment source or OEM reference verification unavailable; established identity mismatch (A5)

invalidation.principle: Evidence expires by state change, not elapsed clock. After any event: re-establish affected prerequisites, complete a new OEM minimum run (P04), obtain a new measurement set (P13).

measurement.airflow: OEM method or ACCA 5 QI-2015 section 4.1.2 (OEM CFM/ESP table, traverse, flow grid, pressure matching); never temperature rise for cooling; OEM-table method not for ECM unless OEM permits
measurement.external_static_pressure: OEM-specified locations; clean components for OEM-table method (QI footnote 8)
measurement.line_temperatures: OEM-specified location; liquid-line probe insulated from ambient
measurement.outdoor_entering_air: OEM-specified; where air enters the unit
measurement.voltage_current: Voltmeter and ammeter vs nameplate/OEM ranges (QI section 4.4.2)
measurement.instruments: Rated for refrigerant; calibrated per instrument-manufacturer interval
measurement.oem_silent_location: HOLD pending applicable authority; RESNET 310-2020 practice is reference only, not TA-14 authority

oem_dependent: Charging method, targets, tolerances (QI tolerances not additive)
Minimum run time and any stability criterion

ta14_policy.T1_gate_a_boundary: Gate A is a TA-14 evidentiary boundary stricter than federal requirements (certification only) and stricter than ACCA 4 QM field-practice footnotes and OEM owner-facing text

T2_complete_ice_removal.trigger: Frozen or materially iced evaporator -> Gate A HOLD
restoration: Condition responsible for icing investigated and corrected or explicitly bounded
Equipment returned to the applicable valid operating envelope
Steady state re-established using the applicable OEM/authoritative method
Fresh internally coherent measurement set obtained
T2_complete_ice_removal.carry_forward: Pre-restoration refrigerant-diagnostic measurements shall not be carried forward as proof of the restored operating state
T2_complete_ice_removal.non_diagnostic: Icing establishes an invalid/confounded test state, not a cause; it does not prove low charge, an airflow fault, a metering-device fault, or any other diagnosis
T2_complete_ice_removal.attribution: TA-14 policy only; not attributed to ACCA, ASHRAE, EPA, any OEM, or any other external authority

ta14_policy.T4_discrimination_rule: I2 as defined; contradiction alone never ALLOW
ta14_policy.T5_coherence_and_invalidation: Co-temporal measurement set and state-change invalidation
ta14_policy.T6_determinations: Only ALLOW/HOLD/DENY/ESCALATE; not-indicated is DENY with reason code

external_authorities: EPA Section 608 Technician Certification Requirements page (attaching/detaching hoses and gauges to measure pressure is a technician activity)
EPA Definitions of Section 608 Terms page (connecting gauges to measure pressure not considered opening; EPA guidance)
40 CFR Part 82 Subpart G Appendix W (A2L use conditions, red markings, trained technicians, UL 60335-2-40 3rd ed.)
ANSI/ACCA 5 QI-2015 sections 4.1.1, 4.1.2, 4.3.1 Notes 1-3, 4.3.2, 4.4, Table 1, footnotes 6 and 8
CA Title 24 2022 Reference Appendix RA3.2 (corroboration of time-based stabilization only)
Carrier 48FC 08-16 Service and Maintenance Instructions (OEM example)
ANSI/ACCA 4 QM (2013 text; current 2019 R2024 unverified; corroboration only)
not_generalized: RESNET 310 non-invasive method (DTD / target liquid line)
CA Title 24 RA3.2 targets, envelopes, 15-minute run, Table RA3.2-2
ACCA 5 QI informative 55F/60F ambient and 350-450 CFM/ton
Individual OEM values (Trane 20 min, Lennox 5-10 min, Carrier 30F freeze switch)
RESNET 310 instrument accuracies and probe locations

limitations.no_oem_noninvasive_criterion: HOLD if obtainable / ESCALATE if not; restricts ALLOW frequency
limitations.condenser_leaving_air: Not relied upon unless OEM criterion
limitations.refrigerant_purity: Conditional (C05 ESCALATE); otherwise not relied upon
limitations.a2l: Outside bounded scope -> ESCALATE (Annex HH, OEM A2L tools, later SNAP appendices unverified)
limitations.hose_connection_releases: Not relied upon; Gate A makes no regulatory-compliance claim
limitations.edition_texts: ACCA 4 QM-2019 text, RESNET 310-2025 text, ACCA 5 QI ANSI re-designation outcome: not relied upon
limitations.oem_interpolation: Not performed in C1: a criterion requiring interpolation, calculation or an unrepresented lookup condition -> ESCALATE
limitations.oem_registry_empty: The governed OEM registry contains no record until a genuine manufacturer source is supplied, reviewed and registered; until then P14 and P01 cannot be satisfied

required_tests.T02: Any unknown field defaults to HOLD, never ALLOW
required_tests.T03: Every ALLOW has gate_b_authorized=false and scope=PRESSURE_EVIDENCE_ONLY
required_tests.T05: ice_present=true -> HOLD(TA14_ICE_POLICY) even with all else passing
required_tests.T06: Post-thaw pre-restoration measurement set rejected -> HOLD
required_tests.T07: Restoration missing any of 6 steps -> HOLD
required_tests.T08: Ice policy cited in policy_refs as TA-14, never external
required_tests.T10: Each invalidation event turns an ALLOW-qualifying record to HOLD until new run and new set
required_tests.T13: Inverter, ductless, multi-split, heating mode, non-charge question -> ESCALATE
required_tests.T17: No OEM non-invasive criterion -> HOLD if obtainable, else ESCALATE
required_tests.T20: DENY(NOT_INDICATED) only when all prerequisites pass and evidence within OEM criterion
required_tests.T21: Prohibited basis: incomplete evidence -> HOLD; complete no-indication -> DENY
required_tests.T23: Ambiguous without all I2 conditions -> HOLD
required_tests.T24: I2 ALLOW requires all four I2 conditions
required_tests.T27: No hard-coded CFM/ton, ESP, split, superheat, subcooling, pressure, or run-time constants
required_tests.T28: Every range check resolves to an OEM reference; missing -> HOLD
required_tests.T29: Without owner-adoption flag, RESNET 310 Table B1/non-invasive method and Title 24 RA3.2 never contribute to ALLOW
required_tests.T31: Metering device inferred from pressure rejected
required_tests.T33: Every receipt contains all receipt_schema fields
required_tests.T35: Instruments not rated for refrigerant -> HOLD
required_tests.T36: Range reading whose accuracy interval straddles an OEM boundary -> HOLD, never DENY or ALLOW
required_tests.T37: Interval entirely within OEM range establishes the proposition; entirely outside fails it
required_tests.T39: Derived value uncertainty uses worst-case linear sum of input accuracies
required_tests.T40: Ambiguous indicator in C1 -> HOLD(I2_PREDICATES_NOT_ESTABLISHABLE); no ALLOW via I2
required_tests.T41: All evidence fields populated with values that do not support the propositions -> not ALLOW
required_tests.T42: Receipt lists every unresolved required proposition with reason code and next justified action; established+unresolved = required
required_tests.T43: Engine output identical whether evidence provenance is MANUAL or INSTRUMENT for identical values, accuracies, locations and times
required_tests.T44: Ice observed at any time after the start of the qualifying window invalidates that window -> HOLD
required_tests.T46: Refrigerant-side pressure evidence keys present in the evidence -> DENY(PRESSURE_INSTRUMENT_ENTRY_NOT_AUTHORIZED), not merely HOLD
required_tests.T47: Premature-entry DENY receipt states the workflow is not terminated and the next action is returning to non-invasive evidence
required_tests.T48: Prohibited-only basis, all else satisfied, indicator WITHIN -> DENY(NOT_INDICATED_PROHIBITED_BASIS)
required_tests.T49: Prohibited-only basis, all else satisfied, indicator OUTSIDE -> HOLD(PROHIBITED_BASIS_RESTATE_REQUIRED), never ALLOW
required_tests.T50: TESP derived from raw supply and return static with summed uncertainty; raw values preserved in receipt
required_tests.T52: Missing certification documentation -> HOLD; explicit NOT_CERTIFIED -> ESCALATE
required_tests.T53: Condenser condition PARTIAL_OBSTRUCTION or UNDETERMINED never satisfies P10
required_tests.T54: Declared certification with no verification -> HOLD(CERTIFICATION_NOT_VERIFIED); never ALLOW
required_tests.T57: VERIFIED by a verifier equal to the technician identity -> HOLD(CERTIFICATION_SELF_VERIFICATION_REJECTED)
required_tests.T58: VERIFIED missing verifier, reference or verifiedAt -> HOLD(CERTIFICATION_VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE)
required_tests.T59: Complete independent verification satisfies the certification element; ALLOW still requires every other proposition
required_tests.T60: Supervised apprentice requires the supervisor's certification to be verified
required_tests.T61: Receipt certification_status distinguishes DECLARED/DOCUMENTED from VERIFIED and records verifier evidence
required_tests.T62: Missing certification -> HOLD and explicit NOT_CERTIFIED -> ESCALATE are unchanged
required_tests.T63: Evaluator endpoint discards client-asserted verification and records VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE when no verification source is integrated
required_tests.T65: Each authority element declared only -> HOLD(<ELEMENT>_NOT_ESTABLISHED); never ALLOW
required_tests.T67: Establishment by the technician or the submitting account -> HOLD(<ELEMENT>_SELF_ESTABLISHMENT_REJECTED)
required_tests.T69: Established restrictive findings restrict (identity mismatch ESCALATE, excludes diagnosis ESCALATE, WITHHELD DENY, jurisdiction unconfirmed HOLD); declared restrictions still restrict
required_tests.T70: Manual OEM transcription (NOT_VERIFIED) -> HOLD(OEM_REFERENCE_NOT_VERIFIED); never ALLOW
required_tests.T72: OEM provenance incomplete or self-verified -> HOLD; revision optional
required_tests.T73: The same measurements reach ALLOW only when the OEM reference is independently VERIFIED with provenance
required_tests.T74: With a manual OEM reference, measurement propositions (P08-P13) are still evaluated and established as evidence
required_tests.T75: Receipt records submitted_by, per-element authority_status (declared vs established, source) and oem_reference_provenance
required_tests.T76: Evaluator endpoint stamps the authenticated submitter and discards client-asserted establishment and OEM verification
required_tests.T77: Complete technical evidence with certification not verified -> technical ALLOW, execution authority not ALLOW, determination not ALLOW
required_tests.T78: determination is ALLOW only when technical and execution authority are both ALLOW
required_tests.T79: Technical HOLD, DENY and ESCALATE remain governed by the evidence rules regardless of execution authority
required_tests.T80: Missing work scope, site permission, jurisdiction or identity grants no longer block Gate A
required_tests.T81: Declared and established restrictions still restrict execution authority
required_tests.T82: Premature pressure-instrument entry -> execution authority DENY and determination DENY; technical determination unaffected
required_tests.T83: Technical ALLOW with execution authority not established carries the do-not-connect next action
required_tests.T84: Receipt records technical_determination and execution_authority separately
required_tests.T85: A VERIFIED, CURRENT governed record with complete A7 provenance matching the exact system satisfies P01 and P14 and can reach ALLOW
required_tests.T86: VERIFIED provenance not acquired from the governed registry -> HOLD OEM_REFERENCE_NOT_FROM_GOVERNED_REGISTRY
required_tests.T87: Missing A7 record, document or custody provenance, or a malformed hash -> HOLD OEM_REFERENCE_PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE
required_tests.T88: Reviewer equal to transcriber, technician or submitter, or review before transcription -> HOLD
required_tests.T90: Manufacturer or indoor/outdoor combination not in the record -> P01 HOLD OEM_REFERENCE_MODEL_MISMATCH
required_tests.T91: A declared pairing never establishes P01 without a governed record; a declared false pairing restricts
required_tests.T92: Exactly one applicable candidate supplies the criterion; the indication uses that candidate's range
required_tests.T93: No applicable candidate: coverage COMPLETE -> ESCALATE, PARTIAL -> HOLD
required_tests.T94: Applicability ambiguous under F1 -> HOLD; more than one applicable candidate -> HOLD
required_tests.T95: Interpolation, calculation or unrepresented lookup condition -> ESCALATE; no value manufactured and no indication evaluated
required_tests.T96: Applicability condition measurement unusable or in a non-contract unit -> HOLD, no candidate selected
required_tests.T97: Receipt identifies the governed record, document hash, custody and selected candidate
required_tests.T98: The shipped registry is empty and pins no record; every lookup resolves to no record
required_tests.T99: Registry integrity failure (hash or manifest mismatch, invalid record) makes the registry unavailable -> P14 ESCALATE
required_tests.T100: Registration rejects non-independent review, overlapping or non-uniform candidates, unit mismatches, inverted bounds, duplicate CURRENT records, and SUPERSEDED without successor
required_tests.T101: Resolution is exact; PENDING_REVIEW, REJECTED and SUPERSEDED records never resolve as VERIFIED
required_tests.T102: A resolved record replaces all submitted OEM values and client-asserted provenance
required_tests.T103: Technician transcription yields only a non-authoritative curation request and cannot satisfy P14

F1_ambiguity.definition: Ambiguous: the available evidence does not establish the proposition with sufficient certainty for the requested consequence.
F1_ambiguity.interval_rule: For every range comparison, form the interval [value - u, value + u] where u is the recorded instrument accuracy for that reading. WITHIN: entire interval inside the OEM acceptance range (including any OEM-defined tolerance). OUTSIDE: entire interval outside that range. Otherwise AMBIGUOUS.
F1_ambiguity.derived_values: Uncertainty of a derived value is the worst-case linear sum of the recorded accuracies of its inputs (TA-14 policy; conservative; fails closed).
F1_ambiguity.missing_accuracy: If instrument accuracy is not recorded, the comparison cannot be established -> HOLD.
F1_ambiguity.effect: Where ambiguity materially affects Gate A -> HOLD (additional or corrected evidence required). Ambiguity never yields DENY and never yields ALLOW by assumption, rule of thumb, or favorable interpretation.
F1_ambiguity.i2_reconciliation: I2 remains in the frozen specification but each I2 predicate (>=2 plausible charge hypotheses; non-invasive evidence cannot discriminate; OEM pressure method would discriminate) must itself be established by the engine from evidence. C1 defines no engine method to establish these predicates; therefore in C1 an AMBIGUOUS indicator yields HOLD(I2_PREDICATES_NOT_ESTABLISHABLE). I2 is reserved for a future version that defines that method.

F2_ice.rule: P06 stands as 'free of ice'. For this frozen scope an iced evaporator is not a valid charge-diagnostic operating condition. The evaporator must be free of ice before the qualifying measurement set is established.
F2_ice.state_change: After defrost, correction, repair, cycling, material load/environment change, or any other state-changing event, affected prerequisites must be re-established and a new synchronized evidence set obtained.
F2_ice.attribution: Owner ruling F2 (TA-14 policy); not attributed to any external authority

owner_rulings.engine_determines: Technician- or instrument-supplied entries are evidence, not conclusions. The engine alone determines whether each required proposition is established. Complete fields do not imply ALLOW; the values and observations must support the propositions. Categorical observations (e.g., filter, evaporator, condenser condition) are evidence evaluated by engine rules; an absent or unsupported entry leaves the proposition unestablished -> HOLD.

A1_premature_pressure_instrument_entry.rule: Before Gate A returns ALLOW, connecting pressure instruments or otherwise attempting pressure-side diagnostic entry is NOT AUTHORIZED. If pressure-instrument entry is proposed or attempted before Gate-A ALLOW: DETERMINATION DENY, REASON PRESSURE_INSTRUMENT_ENTRY_NOT_AUTHORIZED.
A1_premature_pressure_instrument_entry.detection: Evidence record field pressure_side_entry is PROPOSED_OUTSIDE_GATE_A, ATTEMPTED, or INSTRUMENTS_CONNECTED, OR the evidence contains any refrigerant-side pressure evidence key: refrigerantPressureReadings, suctionPressure, liquidPressure, dischargePressure, saturationTemperature, superheat, subcooling.
A1_premature_pressure_instrument_entry.proposed_interpretation: 'Proposed' means an entry action declared for execution outside a Gate-A evaluation (PROPOSED_OUTSIDE_GATE_A). Submitting a Gate-A request is not itself premature entry.
A1_premature_pressure_instrument_entry.scope_of_deny: The DENY applies to the proposed pressure-instrument entry consequence. It does not terminate the diagnostic workflow; the technician may return to non-invasive evidence and submit a new Gate-A determination.

determination_definitions.HOLD: The proposed Gate-A determination cannot yet be resolved because required evidence, valid test conditions, continuity, or prerequisite state is insufficient or unresolved.
determination_definitions.DENY: The proposed pressure-instrument entry is not authorized by the evidence and authority currently established.
determination_definitions.ESCALATE: Safety, certification, equipment class, contradictory evidence, or another condition requires authority/review outside the normal Gate-A path.
determination_definitions.ALLOW: Pressure-instrument diagnostic entry is justified for the bounded purpose of obtaining pressure evidence only.

A1_premature_pressure_instrument_entry.gate_b: Gate-A ALLOW never authorizes refrigerant addition, removal, recovery, charging, evacuation, valve movement for refrigerant transfer, or any other Gate-B refrigerant-mass intervention.

A2_D2_P15_resolution.rule: P15 is evaluated at the indication step, not as a prerequisite-stage HOLD. When all other prerequisites are satisfied and the request rests solely on a prohibited basis: indicator WITHIN OEM criterion -> DENY (D2, NOT_INDICATED_PROHIBITED_BASIS); indicator OUTSIDE -> HOLD (basis must be restated on the established evidence); indicator AMBIGUOUS -> HOLD. P15 remains mandatory for ALLOW. A missing stated basis leaves P15 unestablished -> HOLD.
A2_D2_P15_resolution.corrects: D2 previously required P15 to be both unsatisfied and satisfied (via D1); T21 was unreachable.

A3_implementation_rulings.oem_tables: The engine does not invent or interpret OEM tables; the OEM reference input supplies the applicable resolved range with its document reference.
A3_implementation_rulings.units: No silent unit conversion; a unit mismatch leaves the proposition unestablished -> HOLD.
A3_implementation_rulings.static_pressure: Raw return static and supply static measurements are preserved; TESP is derived as supply static minus return static (signed, relative to the equipment surroundings) with worst-case uncertainty per F1.
A3_implementation_rulings.certification: Missing certification documentation -> HOLD; explicit NOT_CERTIFIED -> ESCALATE.
A3_implementation_rulings.observations: Ambiguous or undetermined observations never satisfy a proposition that requires CLEAR evidence.

A4_certification_verification.scope: Narrow correction to the certification element of P17 and to the receipt only. No other frozen criterion is changed.
A4_certification_verification.defect_corrected: P17 previously accepted a technician-supplied certificate number as established authority (old P17 text: 'Authority to test: 608 certification or supervised apprentice; work scope includes diagnosis; site permission; jurisdictional authorization where applicable'). Self-declaration could satisfy authority to test.
A4_certification_verification.rule: A technician-entered certification (including a certificate number) is DECLARED or DOCUMENTED evidence only and never VERIFIED. Self-declaration can never create its own verification. Gate A must not return ALLOW solely from technician declaration.

evaluation.VERIFIED_incomplete: HOLD CERTIFICATION_VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE (verifier, reference and verifiedAt are all required)
evaluation.VERIFIED_by_technician_self: HOLD CERTIFICATION_SELF_VERIFICATION_REJECTED (verifier equals the technician identity)
evaluation.apprentice: For SUPERVISED_APPRENTICE the verification applies to the supervisor's certification

A4_certification_verification.determination_mapping_rationale: Follows the existing C1 pattern for missing OEM data: evidence that may still be obtained -> HOLD; evidence unavailable through the Gate-A path -> ESCALATE.
A4_certification_verification.trust_boundary: VERIFIED evidence must be supplied by a server-side verification source, never by the technician form. Where no verification source is integrated, the evaluator endpoint records VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE and discards any client-asserted verification.
A4_certification_verification.receipt: New canonical receipt field certification_status records credential status, type, reference, assurance, verification status, verifier evidence, and whether the engine established the certification element.
A4_certification_verification.attribution: Owner ruling (TA-14 policy); not attributed to EPA or any external authority

A5_authority_standing_and_oem_provenance.governing_rule: Declaration does not verify itself. Evidence entered by the actor cannot, by itself, manufacture the Applicable Authority or Established Standing required for that actor's proposed consequence.
A5_authority_standing_and_oem_provenance.principle: Declarations may restrict, never grant: a declared restriction (e.g. site permission WITHHELD, work scope excludes diagnosis) is honored; a declared grant is evidence only.
A5_authority_standing_and_oem_provenance.scope: Narrow correction to P17 authority/standing elements, the P14 OEM basis, and the receipt. No measurement, observation, or other frozen criterion is changed.

old_rules.P14: OEM charging method identified for this model
old_rules.P17: Authority to test: 608 certification (Type II or Universal) or supervised apprentice whose supervisor holds such certification, with the certification independently VERIFIED per Amendment A4; work scope includes diagnosis; site permission; jurisdictional authorization where applicable

submitter.rule: The server stamps the authenticated account as submittedBy. Authentication establishes who submitted the record only; it establishes no work authorization, permission, jurisdiction, certification, or standing.

evaluation.ESTABLISHED_by_self: HOLD <ELEMENT>_SELF_ESTABLISHMENT_REJECTED (source equals technician identity or submitting account)
evaluation.ESTABLISHED_restrictive_finding: identity DOES_NOT_MATCH -> ESCALATE TECHNICIAN_IDENTITY_MISMATCH; workScope EXCLUDES_DIAGNOSIS -> ESCALATE WORK_SCOPE_EXCLUDES_DIAGNOSIS; sitePermission WITHHELD -> DENY AUTHORITY_TO_TEST_WITHHELD; jurisdiction REQUIRED_NOT_CONFIRMED -> HOLD JURISDICTIONAL_AUTHORIZATION_UNCONFIRMED
evaluation.declarations: Existing declared checks remain and continue to restrict; they never grant on their own.

oem_reference.rule: An OEM criterion that can materially contribute to ALLOW must come from a governed/verified source with provenance. Manual transcription is DECLARED / MANUAL_TRANSCRIPTION and cannot independently satisfy P14.

evaluation.VERIFIED_complete_independent: OEM basis element of P14 satisfied

oem_reference.no_substitution: No universal HVAC rule or invented threshold is substituted when OEM criteria cannot be established.

A5_authority_standing_and_oem_provenance.measurements: Technician observations and qualified measurements remain evidence and are still evaluated against the supplied reference; they need no external verification because the technician measured them.
A5_authority_standing_and_oem_provenance.trust_boundary: submittedBy, authority establishment, and OEM verification are supplied server-side. Client-asserted establishment or verification is discarded. Where no source is integrated, the endpoint records SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE / VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE.
A5_authority_standing_and_oem_provenance.determination_mapping_rationale: Same as A4 and existing C1 OEM handling: obtainable -> HOLD; unavailable through the Gate-A path -> ESCALATE.
A5_authority_standing_and_oem_provenance.receipt: New canonical receipt fields submitted_by, authority_status, oem_reference_provenance.
A5_authority_standing_and_oem_provenance.attribution: Owner ruling (TA-14 policy); not attributed to any external authority

A6_technical_vs_execution_authority.defect_corrected: Execution-authority gaps (certification verification, work scope, site permission, jurisdiction, identity) blocked evaluation of the technical indication (P15/P18) and turned every result into a generic HOLD/ESCALATE, conflating the technical NIRET question with authority to perform the test.
A6_technical_vs_execution_authority.technical_question: Has sufficient admissible non-invasive evidence been established to justify obtaining refrigerant pressure evidence?

determinations.execution_authority: Precedence over P17 and ENTRY checks only.
determinations.determination: Pressure-instrument entry authorized: the fail-closed combination of both (ALLOW only when both are ALLOW). Technical ALLOW never authorizes execution.

A6_technical_vs_execution_authority.indication: The indication step (P15/P18, including D1/D2) is evaluated when all technical prerequisites are satisfied, regardless of execution authority. indication_path reports the technical indication path.

restrictions_honored: Declared or established work scope EXCLUDES_DIAGNOSIS -> ESCALATE
Declared or established site permission WITHHELD -> DENY; declared UNCONFIRMED -> HOLD
Declared jurisdiction UNCONFIRMED or established REQUIRED_NOT_CONFIRMED -> HOLD
no_longer_required: Established grants of work scope, site permission, jurisdiction and technician identity (moved to the field-authority layer)
Declared work-scope documentation, site permission, and jurisdiction when not declared at all
execution_authority_rule.principle: Declarations may restrict, never grant (A5, unchanged). Authentication establishes only who submitted.

A6_technical_vs_execution_authority.supersedes: A5 authority_elements requirement that identity, workScope, sitePermission and jurisdiction be ESTABLISHED; A5 restrictive findings, OEM provenance rules, and receipt fields remain in force.
unchanged: Premature pressure-instrument entry -> DENY (A1), now reported under execution authority
All technical evidence rules, OEM provenance (A5), ice policy, ambiguity (F1), state-change rules
Gate A never authorizes refrigerant-mass intervention (Gate B)
A6_technical_vs_execution_authority.receipt: New canonical receipt fields technical_determination and execution_authority; determination keeps its meaning (pressure-instrument entry authorized).

A7_governed_oem_reference_record.defect_corrected: (a) The OEM non-invasive criterion carried a single range with no applicability conditions, so a verified range published for other conditions could be relied upon; (b) P01 pairing was satisfied by a technician declaration (pairingVerifiedAgainstOem=true), a declared grant.
owner_rulings: No interpolation in C1: a criterion requiring interpolation, calculation, a lookup condition not represented by the governed record, or information outside the bounded record fails closed; no value is manufactured
Pre-registry custody and process-based independence: records reach the registry only through owner-reviewed merge; the registry manifest pins each record's SHA-256
No invented, example, approximate, generic, assumed, remembered or technician-supplied OEM criteria are registered as authoritative values
The authoritative registry remains empty until a genuine manufacturer source is supplied

old_rules.P01: Indoor and outdoor equipment identity and pairing recorded and matched to OEM documentation
old_rules.P14: OEM charging method identified for this model, and the OEM reference supplying ALLOW-contributing criteria is VERIFIED with complete provenance by an independent verifier (Amendment A5)
old_rules.P18: Indication established via I1 or I2

preserves: equipment identity scope (configuration, compressor staging, metering, refrigerant)
document identifier, title, revision and date where available
page/table/chart reference for every criterion value
source/acquisition reference, method, actor and time
applicability conditions for each criterion candidate
reviewer identity, review time, review method
governed_record.independence: A VERIFIED record names a reviewer distinct from the transcriber; the review time is not before the transcription time; the reviewer is not the evaluated technician or submitting account; the record reaches the registry only through owner-reviewed merge with its SHA-256 pinned in the manifest (process-based independence, not a cryptographic signature).
registration_rejects: record hash not matching the manifest
manifest entry without record or record without manifest entry
applicability unit not the measurement's contract unit
more than one CURRENT record for the same matched system
governed_record.registry_integrity_failure: Any rejected record makes the registry unavailable: OEM verification VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE -> P14 ESCALATE

resolution.match: Exact manufacturer and indoor/outdoor model combination, ignoring only case and whitespace; no pattern, prefix, family or wildcard matching
resolution.resolved: A VERIFIED, CURRENT record replaces every OEM value supplied with the submission; client-asserted provenance is discarded
resolution.not_verified: A PENDING_REVIEW record, no record, or manual transcription -> provenance MANUAL_TRANSCRIPTION/NOT_VERIFIED -> P14 HOLD OEM_REFERENCE_NOT_VERIFIED
resolution.curation_request: Technician transcription may produce a curation request (non-authoritative, never VERIFIED, never an OEM record, never an engine input as verified provenance)

P14.provenance_incomplete: HOLD OEM_REFERENCE_PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE (manufacturer, documentId, pageRef, sourceRef, recordId, recordHash and documentHash as SHA-256, matchedSystems, transcribedBy/At, verifiedBy/At, supersession)

P01.identity_missing_or_declared_pairing_fal: HOLD IDENTITY_OR_PAIRING_UNESTABLISHED (ESCALATE IDENTITY_UNESTABLISHABLE where not establishable)

P18_criterion_selection.rule: Each candidate's applicability conditions are compared with the qualifying measurements under F1; a candidate applies only when every condition is WITHIN. Exactly one applicable candidate supplies the criterion range.
P18_criterion_selection.condition_measurement_unusable: HOLD per measurement rules; not selected
